profile.name: Alex Morgan
profile.headline: Machine Learning Engineer
profile.status: Open to senior ML engineering roles
profile.bio: I build production ML systems — from training pipelines to low-latency LLM inference. Currently leading model serving at Northwind AI, where our platform handles 40M+ requests a day.

about: I'm a machine learning engineer with six years of experience taking models from prototype to production. My work sits where modeling meets infrastructure: distributed training, evaluation you can trust, and serving that stays fast and affordable under real traffic.

Lately I've focused on LLM systems — retrieval, fine-tuning, and the evaluation harnesses that tell you whether a change actually made things better. I care about measurable impact, reproducible experiments, and code other engineers enjoy working in.

experience.summary: Tech lead for the inference platform behind Northwind's LLM products.
highlights: Cut p95 latency 42% and GPU cost 35% by moving serving to vLLM with continuous batching, FP8 quantization, and speculative decoding.
Designed the offline and online evaluation pipeline that gates every model release; it caught three quality regressions before launch.
Scaled the platform from 2M to 40M+ requests a day on Kubernetes with zero-downtime model rollouts.

experience.summary: Built clinical NLP models that help care teams triage patient messages at 200+ hospitals.
highlights: Shipped a transformer-based triage classifier (F1 0.91, +9 pts over the rules baseline) serving 1.5M messages a month.
Built a HIPAA-compliant training pipeline on SageMaker with automated retraining and drift monitoring.
Introduced experiment tracking with MLflow and mentored four junior engineers.

experience.summary: Trained perception models for warehouse picking robots.
highlights: Raised object-detection mAP by 6 points with a synthetic-data augmentation pipeline.
